items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: By his name was Gerta something. I've forgotten, but they started calling it Goodtown.

ctx.x: Up River. Not in St. James Parish.

No. Where Audubon Park is today, that was Greenberg, Louisiana. That gave birth to one of the largest group of soldiers called the Buffalo Soldiers that emanated, was born right here in Greenberg, Louisiana, where Audubon Park is today. That's the story I wanted to relate to. And it's a true story. If you look in history, that's the way it is. Okay. And all that's part of the Carrollton area. Okay. Mm-hmm. So there are other things that, you know, Carrollton has given us great, when you think about Goodtown.…
